Description: Someone who fights for nothing else but money, why have good morals when money is the only true reason to fight. Money makes the galaxy spin, and with the frequent need for private security, mercenaries have always found a place in the galaxy, one might even say as long as there are mercenaries there is civilization and order.

Background is that of those who’ve flown ships between the stars, or even just systems in the many solar systems the council contains. Transpo-Truckers, fighter pilots, Pleasure cruise captains, all of them bear this similarity, no matter what they chose to do, they all flew in the Void.

Miner’s born and raised, surveyors and journeymen drillers, the people who provide the materials the galaxy needs to keep running. Whether it’s on a barren moon, some forgotten asteroid, or a hell scape of scrap and rust. Prospectors are those who search for mineral wealth, and have the knowledge and tools to find them.

Someone who’s been experienced with the many applications of scientific endeavors and the massive amount of fields that exist, from the simplest to the most complex they all consider one another fellows, for as UGIS loves to coin an old human phrase, “A rising tide lifts all ships” Many swear their allegiance to the government faction of that of the greatest collection of scientific minds in the galaxy. UGIS.
Background is that of a former paid government soldier from any of the various military factions that exist. Notable factions are UHAM, Suundrii Legion, Illialia Armed Forces.

Assassins, Hitmen, killers for hire, this title has many names. As an ancient saying goes, so long as there’s two people that have a disagreement, someone is going to want someone dead. Whether it is a personal vendetta, or settling a bounty that got away, assassins have a place on both sides of the law.

Someone often associated with leadership, from being military officers, commanders or captains of spacecraft, all find their place alongside others issuing commands and telling others orders. Though more often than not they have to be the ones to fix things.

Forgotten? Lost? Marooned? Shipwrecked? You’ve been forgotten on the reaches and yet here you are again, with scars and strange markings chronicling your return from the edges of the galaxy. What deals and pacts did you have to make to return to civilization? What horrible things did you agree to? What nightmares have you lived through just to get back to civilization and be shunned for being so disheveled and strange. The cryptic symbols and scars on your flesh suggest insanity, but is it?

Background contains things associated with a student of the medical field, who’s spent years in various pharmaceutical corporations and industries. Though some companies definitely abide by any sort of oaths or morals. Doctors can come in a variety of flavors and experiences.

The wayward lost souls who have no home, the space truckers who spend every waking moment ensuring someone gets deliveries on time, Vagabond, wanderer, freelancer, man for hire; all people who fall onto the title of ‘Drifter’. Many of whom normally go unnoticed by the society the galaxy runs on. Though to the drifters they know exactly where the money flows, which jobs are gold mines, and which are fools errands. You wander the sea of stars with the knowledge the stars will take you to which destination you're supposed to be.

Someone associated with the dark arts of digital theft, no longer are pick-pockets necessary when a hacker is ever safer, sitting far away from prying eyes accessing things and digging around the Gal-net where the firewalls are weak and vulnerable.

Whenever you have technology or machinery, inevitably it’ll break, and the job to fix that stuff falls on a humble Mechanic. They come in various clothes and walks of life, from a man keeping things running with the barest of materials and hopes and prayers, to a professional with her own repair bay, in the end they all use their hands to fix what science has built, cause sometimes not even robots are good enough to fix things.
Background contains things akin to ship breaking, hard labor, heavy industrial work, they are the ones keeping society moving. They are the cogs that ensure the lights stay on.

You have no strings no fall back, your existence seems to be one of sheer bad luck, or is it purposeful. Your records are empty, nothing to hold you down, but nothing to protect you when the galaxy often crushes those free of its grasp. Were your records removed? Destroyed? An accident perhaps? No one knows, but you’ve got a sliver of true freedom and that's enough for nobody, like you.

The great and endless fields of stars. It calls many to settle or build, but to a select few it sends them to the farthest reaches of space. These wayward pioneers are the ones who’ve scouted stars, and space lanes, found scientific marvels and horrors in the darkness of space. The act of pioneering the path makes Pioneer’s special, they tread the fields of stars in a way they get to experience its brilliance on a personal level.

Some find the ‘rules’ of society overbearing. . and oftentimes boring, often preferring personal freedom and self enjoyment above all, those people are known as pirates, outlaws, bandits, people who only desire their own freedom and self gain. Whether it be the noble Old families or the modern pirate gangs, pirates are a lifestyle you can’t get rid of.

Everyone expects great things, but time and time again you’re thrust into a new mission, job or assignment. Most times it’s just a passing phase, but sometimes something sticks and you get good at it. You adapt, you overcome. You face challenges squarely because you’ve got something to prove, you may be new at this but so is everything else that's happened to you. Same crap, different day, and frankly it wouldn’t be your life if it wasn’t a challenge. For a rookie like you it’s just another chapter in the story that's your life, adapt to this challenge and kick it in the teeth.

A sight for sore eyes in a galaxy full of suffering and war. Someone who puts themselves last usually ends up a martyr for their cause but for you, saving people comes first, no matter what. Medics, Surgeons, Doctors, emergency responders, people who brave the warzone to desperately save a few more lives, even at the cost of your own. To you it’s a worthy sacrifice, to others, you're a hero; but to those with darkness festering in their blood, you're nothing but a target. At the very least you can live with yourself after everything is said and done, you strove to save lives, not to end them.

Someone who often finds themselves at odds with the law, through coincidence or purpose, scoundrels exist, and will always be there, smugglers, highwaymen, scammers, they all find themselves at some point being called this singular word; Scoundrel.
In Progress

Some Ennu-Aru have been afflicted by a sickness that turns their feathers unnatural colors, and grant them access to a special racial Talent only they can utilize. These poor souls become combat addicts, or emotionally unstable swordsmen.

There have been other houses, other clans of Araka, but now you are the last of your tribe, your house. You alone carry their memory and you’ll make sure it’s not forgotten to the records of history you aim to prove what the last surviving member can do.

You left Cinis, now Cinis is gone, does that make your atonement meaningless? No child of the Ash, you are born to continue your penance to report your success to Princess Bianca, as she is the last of the Royal council of your people. Her word is law, and until she says die, you will live. You must kill enough worthy opponents to get your ashen name back, so that you may also bear that distinguished title for those who complete their atonement. Paladin, a name many Ashen aspire to be one. Your tally starts at 490, kill for your penance, remember only worthy foes count.

The Galactic Security Force, or GSF, one of the most well known and beloved groups by the people in the galaxy. They held the outer reaches of many empires and secured and protected them from pirates. So amicable and well spoken they even were allowed an outpost in the Cinis system, home system of the isolationist Ashen. The GSF was once spread across the galaxy, now they are a legend. Just as the black out was happening the GSF disappeared. Now you are left, you and your sheriff were on patrol taking a ferry from sector to sector when the blackout occurred, heading to receive new standing orders when you were caught in the wave. Now you must find out what caused this and survive. (ONLY PLAYABLE ON CASTAWAY START)

Gestalt is an interesting corporation that's been around since well before the Blackout, but is only really known for their operation of large prison vessels that have a near total fatality rating for the prisoners. They operate in a much reduced capacity nowadays limited to specific large vessels that take the most unwanted of prisoners from what few large prisons remain. Though as an Operative you know the truth of the matter, in fact they are sending you to gather intelligence and gather data, so that the Gestalt corporation can make its return in full. There are several things you must find or secure for the company, and nothing can get in your way. Though you must remain undercover, certain enemies to the corporation are everywhere and you never know where they may be. Please consult the DM for more details about Gestalt.

Prior to the Blackout the Galactic Bounty Hunter Authority was the only competition to the GSF and now is the only one of the two organizations left. The Bounty hunters are those who seek to bring justice to those who’ve escaped it. There are many infamous hunters though few reach the acclaim that Baron does. Bounty hunters by and large are a lonely sort that don’t tend to group with others, but in this day and age of the Galaxy a group of friends is a necessity for them to ensure the elimination of the bounties being put out on those in the wider galactic reaches.

You had been a young bright eyed junior researcher, eager to join the rapidly expanding Ouroboros company. Though that eagerness and joy was short-lived, as it turns out you became the subject of their experiments, pushing your body to the limits of what it can physically do. Sentient Experimentation using their interns was a horrific experience, which due to the collapse of the company, and the fact many of their own creations don’t attack other things built by ouroboros ensured you survived, but now you must hide what they’ve done to you, these unnatural abilities are powerful but they come at a cost.

Some gaze at the stars wondering what lies out there, but for those seldom few. . those 1 in a billion, it looks back and speaks to them. Those poor individuals find themselves ostracized and outcast, speaking of horrors and darkness no one else is willing to hear. Though for those burdened by this knowledge it often leads them to truly strange and beautiful places few else would ever experience. Sadly whatever has touched them and causes technology to misbehave in their presence.
